setting: The Ember Watch, on the night the ash first fell
opening: The Watch has stood at the edge of the world for a thousand years. Tonight its eyes are closed.

roles.name: Watch Slave
roles.description: A slave of the Ember Watch, chained to its stores. Nobody here will miss you.

roles.name: Lamplighter
roles.description: Keeper of the Watch's lamps. The towers have been dark for a long time.

roles.name: Sworn Guard
roles.description: Sworn to the walls, to die on them if you must.

roles.name: Ash Pilgrim
roles.description: You came a long way to watch the end of the world.

events.spell: The horizon greys. Something burrows through the ash towards the walls.
The first flakes of ash fall on the Watch. Heavy things climb the cliffs.
The ash falls thick now. Someone outside the gate is calling your name.
The Herald's host comes on and on.

tyrant.name: The Ash Herald
tyrant.spell: The Ash Herald stands before the gate. The ash obeys it.

endings.deed: You lit the lamps of the Ember Watch, and the Watch saw the ash coming.
endings.comment: The Watch opened its eyes. For one more night, the edge of the world held.
endings.role_deed: A Lamplighter kept the lamps, as was their fate.

endings.deed: You slew the Ash Herald before the gate.
endings.comment: The Herald fell, and the ash fell with it. The Watch never learned who saved it.
endings.role_deed: A Sworn Guard held the wall, as was their oath.

endings.deed: You lived to see a grey dawn.
endings.comment: The night ended, and the Watch with it. You only endured.
endings.role_deed: An Ash Pilgrim watched the end of the world, as they had come to.

comments.Poor: Poor. You survived. The Watch would not have noticed you either way.
comments.Adequate: Adequate. The Watch would have been grateful, had it lived.
comments.Good: Good. Few who stand in the ash stand so well.
comments.Excellent: Excellent. Few could have kept the Watch standing until morning.
comments.Glorious: Glorious. The Spell will remember this vigil.

lore: The Ember Watch kept its lamps lit at the edge of the world for a thousand years. On the night the ash first fell, the lamps were dark. What is left of the Watch still stands in the Ashen Expanse.
